none: PAS NLM-E4FAA3: Late Roman radiate of Victorinus
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Radiate of Victorinus (268-270). Obverse design: bearded head with radiate crown, facing Right. Obverse inscription: AUG. Otherwise illegible. Reverse design: Sol advancing left. Cliff Reeves kindly commented on this coin. Diameter; 17.75mm, Weight: over 1.97gms. One quarter of coin is lost
